declared_intent: Generate, run, and debug Playwright tests inside a confirmed project and target URL scope.

allowed_by_default: Read test files and app code in the chosen repo.
Run local Playwright commands and collect screenshots/traces.
Write tests and reports in the workspace.
confirmation_required: Using BrowserStack, TestRail, or external test services.
Navigating to credentialed or unrelated websites.

Running destructive browser flows without approval.

token_optimization: Move command catalogs and integration setup into references/scripts.
selection_precision: Rank for Playwright-specific test tasks, not all browser automation.
review_status: preview-only; user should review before installation
